scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/providers/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint src packages apps tools scripts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm knip && pnpm test && pnpm prefill:verify
scripts.rust:check: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.android:dev: node scripts/mobile-doctor.mjs android && node scripts/tauri.mjs android dev
scripts.android:apk: node scripts/mobile-doctor.mjs android && node scripts/tauri.mjs android build --apk --debug
scripts.ios:dev: node scripts/mobile-doctor.mjs ios && node scripts/tauri.mjs ios dev
scripts.stack:up: node scripts/dev-secrets.mjs && docker compose --env-file deploy/dev.env -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --build --wait
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --env-file deploy/dev.env -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml down
